'''Hrchek Kal Fas''' was a [[Saurin/Legends|Saurin]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] trader from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Durkteel/Legends|Durkteel]]. He employed the [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Nevar Yalnal/Legends|Nevar Yalnal]] as a laborer and his cousin, [[Sai'torr Kal Fas/Legends|Sai'torr Kal Fas]], was his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]. While in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Kal Fas read a posting offering a reward for droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Thirsty, he later visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] with his cousin. Kal Fas nearly captured the wanted droids when they visited the cantina with the [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

==Biography==
Hrchek Kal Fas was a [[Saurin/Legends|Saurin]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="SWE" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SWE" /> [[Durkteel/Legends|Durkteel]]. Kal Fas, a typical [[Droid/Legends|droid]] trader, scouted the [[Invisible Market]] for the best droid prices. Kal Fas employed his<ref name="CSWE" /> Saurin female cousin, [[Sai'torr Kal Fas/Legends|Sai'torr Kal Fas]], as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]],<ref name="Saitorr">{{DB|character|saitorrkalfas|Kal Fas, Sai'torr}}</ref> and also employed the [[Ranat/Legends|Ranat]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Nevar Yalnal/Legends|Nevar Yalnal]] as a laborer.<ref name="Ranat">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Nevar Yalnal}}</ref> While he was on the<ref name="Legacy Collection">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Legacy Collection|pack=#33: Hrchek Kal Fas|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCBD33Hrchek.asp}}</ref> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet<ref name="SWE" /> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Kal Fas frequented [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]<ref name="Legacy Collection" /> in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="Mos Eisley">{{DB|location|moseisley|Mos Eisley}}</ref>

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> while in Mos Eisley<ref name="CSWE" /> buying and selling droids,<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> Kal Fas read a posting that noted a reward for finding two lost droids that belonged to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The post stated that the pair had been stolen from a high [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] who desperately wanted them back because they were close companions. The post was an obvious lie, and the droids<ref name="CSWE" />&mdash;[[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]&mdash;actually belonged to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref> 

A thirsty<ref name="Roll Call">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> Kal Fas then visited Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina,<ref name="Episode IV" /> wisely keeping his bodyguard with him<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and standing at the bar, when the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], searching for a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to take them, C-3PO, and R2-D2 to the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Episode IV" /> Kal Fas nearly found the droids and captured them<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|22|CAN 1-6|Mos Eisley Cantina Characters}}</ref> before [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]] ordered the droids out.<ref name="Episode IV" /> He slowly followed<ref name="CSWE" /> C-3PO,<ref name="Legacy Collection" /> trying not to attract attention, but by the time he made it to the door of Cantina, the droid had disappeared into the crowded streets.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Hrchek-kal-fas.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Hrchek Kal Fas was a tough droid dealer who hailed from Durkteel.]]
Kal Fas was a tough Saurin<ref name="VD" /> who had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="SWE" />

==Equipment==
Kal Fas wore a green [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]], a tan jacket, silver gloves, dark blue pants, and a pair of black boots.<ref name="Episode IV" /> He utilized a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] which he kept in a black [[Holster/Legends|holster]].<ref name="Legacy Collection" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although uncredited, Hrchek Kal Fas was played by [[Laurie Goode]].<ref>{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsinterviews1|url=2010/05/laurie-goode-interview-saurin.html|name=Star Wars Interviews|text=Laurie Goode interview}}</ref>
